title: CMS Blocks
description: Manage storefront content blocks and their display order.

help.title: About CMS Blocks
help.overview: CMS blocks are the sections of your storefront home page, such as a hero banner, a slider, or an announcement bar. The shop shows active blocks whose dates include now, in position order. Type and title are required; choosing a type shows the fields that type needs.

sections.title: Types
items: Hero banner, slider, and promotional section show images with a headline and a call-to-action link.
Featured collection, trending, best sellers, flash sale, grid, and category showcase show products from a collection or categories, up to a limit.
Announcement bar shows a short message with an optional link. Video embeds a video URL.
Custom HTML shows your own markup; it is sanitized before the storefront renders it.

sections.title: When and where it shows
items: Start and end bound when the block is shown. Outside them it stays saved but is not sent to the shop.
Position is the order on the page; Reorder rewrites positions in the order you arrange.
Visibility can limit the block to desktop, tablet, or mobile, and to regions. New blocks show on all devices.
The platform shop that lists every seller does not use any seller's blocks.

sections.title: Status
items: Activate and deactivate show or hide the block without deleting it.
Deleting is a soft delete and it can be restored.

reorderDescription: Drag blocks to change their display order on the storefront.
